head: Tiny Steps baby milestone app: a guide from birth to age five
dek: Tiny Steps: Milestone Guide is a new $1.99 baby milestone app for iPhone and iPad that explains child development from birth to age five, with play ideas for each age. It was #46 among paid Education apps on the US App Store on 23 November.
details: You browse by age or by six skill areas, such as gross motor, language and social and emotional development, and can add your own note and date to a milestone. Notes stay on the device and no account is needed; the app has no ads or analytics, and most of it works offline. It links to sources such as the CDC, NIH and MedlinePlus, and its listing says it's an educational reference, not a diagnostic or screening tool. It came out on 16 November and is made by Vaman Kanu Patel.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store, $1.99
means: If you want plain explanations of what children usually learn at each age, with play ideas, this app keeps them in one place without an account or ads.
todo: Use it as a reference only; for questions about your own child's development, talk to your pediatrician, as the listing itself advises.
